description:
At 57, Debbie Welsch sold her US home and belongings for $550,000, then relocated to Bali with her 82-year-old mother. Today, she pays $375 a month in rent and has built a new life centered on making her savings stretch. In this episode of "Cost of Living," she breaks down exactly what it costs to retire in Bali and how she budgets for life abroad.

For more from Debbie: https://www.youtube.com/@UCQj0vMOtUzZ1OgBqsYY6QNA
